threads.body: The tool-call phase never emits `thread.run.step.delta`. The OpenAI SDK dispatches `on_tool_call_created` and `on_tool_call_delta` from those deltas, not from `thread.run.step.created`/`in_progress`, so these callbacks never fire against this mock even though the `requires_action` handler works. Emit indexed tool-call deltas with initially empty tool-call snapshots to avoid duplicating arguments, and update the event-sequence test to cover them.

Retain the pending tool-call details and emit `thread.run.step.completed` with those outputs before streaming the answer, and cover that lifecycle in the submission test.

Preserve tool-call metadata for replay or cache the submission stream, and add a repeated-request byte-equality test.
